thread:
Joel: Kestrel support reported a 3x drop in throughput after yesterday's 21:00 deploy. p95 went from ~120ms -> ~1.8s. Customer is on a dedicated pool, asking for ETA and mitigation.

Ashwin: looking now, any error spikes or OOMs?

Joel: no OOMs. attaching snippet from their client logs:
```log
2025-11-12T21:05:12Z req=abc123 p95=1812ms qps=12
2025-11-12T21:06:12Z req=abc999 p95=1720ms qps=11
```

Tess: flagged to Kestrel. They want an ETA for SLA credit discussion. Product — please triage priority.

Maria: This looks like a candidate P1 if it's caused by our routing or quantization defaults. Ashwin, can you confirm whether more requests were routed to CPU/fallback variants after the deploy?

Ashwin: initial check: routing table shows ~20% more requests routed to fallback-model-v2 (quantized) after the deploy. Investigating a cost-based routing tweak in rollout A/B. /cc @Luca

Luca: we rolled a routing tweak to prefer lower-cost variants for small requests last night. Could be regressing tail latency. We can revert for the Kestrel cohort.

Joel: Customer confirms they didn't change anything client-side — so server-side for sure.

Maria: Scope and actions: 1) rollback routing tweak for Kestrel (Ashwin) 2) confirm p95 impact (Joel/Ashwin) 3) add postmortem + product backlog item to evaluate cost vs latency defaults (Maria) 4) inform sales re SLA / next steps (Tess).

Ashwin: starting rollback now. Will post results in ~10m. Command I'm running:
```bash
kubectl set env deploy/routing-controller ROUTE_POLICY=stable --namespace=redwood-inference
```

ci-bot: Deploy 984532 started by Ashwin (routing-controller) — canary -> stable

Tess: I'm telling Kestrel we're investigating; they asked about a mitigation (dedicated pinning of model variant) — will discuss costs.

Maria: If revert doesn't resolve, we should prioritize a durable fix in Optimize (latency-aware routing). For now mark P1 and create a backlog ticket.

Ashwin: rollback completed. Early telemetry: p95 trending down from ~1.8s -> ~220ms over the following 15m. Posting short metrics snippet: <link-to-dashboard>

Joel: Kestrel confirms improvement on their side. Closing immediate incident, leaving a backlog action for product+eng to scope an automatic latency-aware routing policy.

Maria: Thanks everyone. Joel, please add the customer intake to the product backlog with SLA terms and Kestrel contact. Use intake slug `customer-intake/Kestrel/latency-2025-11`. I'll review and prioritize for Optimize roadmap.

Joel: Added ticket PLAT-4192 and assigned to Maria. /done :thumbsup:
